lines.en: I decide to spend the afternoon at the library because, somewhere in the back of my mind, I’m probably in the mood to discuss the complexities of incest and things of that nature at length.
lines.zh: 我决定下午泡在图书馆，因为在我脑子深处的某个角落，我大概是来了兴致，想长篇大论地探讨乱伦这回事的复杂性以及诸如此类的东西。

lines.en: Of course, there is only one person I can share in this with (That I am not already related to), and so I greet Nodoka with whatever my max amount of enthusiasm is and take a seat at the table.
lines.zh: 当然，能跟我一起聊这个的只有一个人（一个我还没血缘关系的），所以我用尽了自己最大限额的热情跟 Nodoka 打了招呼，在桌边坐下。

lines.en: The conversation proceeds as you’d expect, with the two of us going in circles and bouncing innuendos off of one another.
lines.zh: 对话如你所料地进行着——我们绕着圈子，把各种暗示丢来丢去。

lines.en: But, in a weird sort of way, it starts to feel as if we’re developing some sort of code-
lines.zh: 但奇怪的是，这开始让我们觉得像是摸索出了某种暗号——

lines.en: Like we understand each other without ever having to divulge any actual details about ourselves which, to me, is pretty great considering I don’t have all that many to divulge to begin with.
lines.zh: 好像我们不用坦白任何关于自己的真实细节就能互相理解。对我来说这简直太棒了，毕竟我本来也没多少细节可以坦白。

lines.en: We reach a point where we run out of steam and convert from constant chatter to silence- but it’s not the sort of awkward silence I’d experience with most people.
lines.zh: 聊到后来我们没劲了，从喋喋不休切换成沉默——但这不是我跟大多数人相处时那种尴尬的沉默。

lines.en: Nodoka buries her face in a book, kicking her feet up on the table in complete disregard for whether or not I’ll be able to look up her skirt.
lines.zh: Nodoka 把脸埋进书里，把脚翘到桌上，完全不在乎我会不会往她裙子里看。

lines.en: Unfortunately, she presses her legs together just before I’m able to actually see anything before smugly winking at me and telling me I don’t have enough Nodoka points.
lines.zh: 可惜，就在我快要看见点什么的时候，她把腿并拢了，还得意地冲我眨眨眼，说我的 Nodoka 点数不够。

lines.en: I am infuriated by having to redeem currency in order to have my curiosity sated, so I tell her she can keep her points as I make my way to the door, hoping it will make her reconsider.
lines.zh: 居然要靠兑换点数才能满足好奇心，我气坏了，于是临出门前跟她说点数她留着吧，盼着她能回心转意。

lines.en: It does not and I am forced to use my imagination as I exit the school and hope that whoever I see next will allow me to see them in some state of undress.
lines.zh: 她没有。我只能靠想象力过活，走出学校，祈祷下一个遇到的人肯让我看看她衣衫不整的样子。
